hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Africa, north of South Africa || predominantly flat to gently rolling tableland; Kalahari Desert in southwest || landlocked; sparsely populated with most settlement concentrated in the southern and eastern parts of the country; geography dominated by the Kalahari Desert, which covers about 70% of the country, although the Okavango Delta brings considerable biodiversity as one of the largest inland deltas in the World || Resources: diamonds, copper, nickel, salt, soda ash, potash, coal, iron ore, silver || Exports: diamonds, copper ore, insulated wire, carbonates, cattle (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: predominantly flat to gently rolling tableland; Kalahari Desert in southwest || Southern Africa, north of South Africa

climate.excerpt: semiarid; warm winters and hot summers || periodic droughts; seasonal August winds blow from the west, carrying sand and dust across the country, which can obscure visibility

economy.excerpt: good economic governance and financial management; diamond-driven growth model declining; rapid poverty reductions; high unemployment, particularly among youth; COVID-19 sharply contracted the economy and recovery is slow; public sector wages have posed fiscal challenges || Exports: diamonds, copper ore, insulated wire, carbonates, cattle (2023) || Industries: diamonds, copper, nickel, salt, soda ash, potash, coal, iron ore, silver; beef processing; textiles
